title: Mixed Event — At This Festival Bathed in Twilight — Episode3 The Night Before The Festival

meta.Event: At This Festival Bathed in Twilight
meta.Episode: Episode3 — The Night Before The Festival
meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu continues to study for her medical school entrance exams while developing some angst towards her mother. However, she ends up volunteering for a big festival called Shibuya Festa and...

rows.Line: The day before Shibuya Festa
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we call things here for today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
Tomorrow's finally Shibuya Festa!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm a little nervous since we won't be playing in front of our usual kind of audience.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand how you feel. It probably is going to feel a bit different. This reminds me of the first time we performed with anemone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that was definitely a hard one to the gut.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. And yet, you were all ultimately able to get through to that audience with your song, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I'm sure this performance will go just fine. As long as you give it your best, I'm sure people will be willing to listen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We don't know anything about the other bands or what the people you play for are actually like, but it's clear that your performances have improved significantly. You should feel confident in your abilities.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you...
You're both right. We promise to stand proud as we play.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's really believe in ourselves and give it absolutely everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'm still surprised by how you suggested that we play at Shibuya Festa, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was under the impression that you weren't all that interested in these sorts of events.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... Festivals in Shibuya do have a tendency to scare me away, and I definitely hesitated when I saw the poster for it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I realized that it would be a chance for us to have more people hear our songs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The songs you write really are wonderful, Saki, while Ichika and Shiho just continue to become better performers...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So I think it's a shame that we've only been able to play at live houses. I want more people to hear our incredible music, which led me to suggest that we play at this event.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. We've definitely been getting better as a band, so it is a good idea for us to try performing at various types of venues...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for suggesting this, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's do our best to really get our name out there!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. The flyers advertising that we'll be playing at Shibuya Festa are done.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Flyers?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I saw that bands appearing at the festival are allowed to advertise themselves using their own flyers, so I decided to make one for us. How does it look...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! This looks awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A navy blue base with a star-studded background. I really like how it represents us so well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does.
Your illustration's also pretty good, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Isn't it?
Hehe. C'mon, praise me some more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, calm down.
I know what happens when you get showered with praise.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But your art really packs a punch, Honami. You asking to draw things yourself probably surprised me the most.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... So...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm still embarrassed by what I draw...
But Ena said that my art left a strong impression on her, so it seemed like a good way for others to see who we really are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm sure others are gonna remember! I mean, your art has such a unique flavor to it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
Like this cute, little dandelion.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Miku, I thought that was a hedgehog...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um... It's a lion...
It's supposed to be the Leo from Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry!
It looked like it was covered in spikes to me...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's okay, you two.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can start handing these flyers out tomorrow, get our name out there and present everybody with the best show we can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
How was that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really amazing!
You were in more sync than usual for the dance routine too! I sort of just ended up staring the whole time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too!
And you've all improved so much. That training camp you girls did must be paying off.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You in particular, Minori.
You've become such a better performer!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I have?!
Oh, thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Way to go, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And it's not just you.
We still have some small adjustments to make, but we're definitely all running on all cylinders now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. If we keep this up, I'm sure everyone at both Shibuya Festa and our solo show will really enjoy our performances.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And tomorrow's the big day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
As the morning's opening act too...
I'm so glad we got this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, how do we ever thank Nanamin for this? I never thought that we'd get to perform at a big, outdoor venue right before our solo show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me neither.
So, let's do our best tomorrow to spread and inspire hope in everyone across Shibuya from that stage tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the spirit!
Actually, maybe a little too much spirit...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I understand the feeling.
It'll be my first performance in quite a while at an outdoor venue. A big one at that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Please wait here just one second!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting!
How about we all have some of these together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are these manjus...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! I bought them yesterday thinking that we must all be tired after working so hard during practices.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... MEIKO and KAITO did say that sweets can help one relax.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See? We really have been working hard these past few days, so wouldn't it be nice to relax while having some nice sweets?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, that does sound nice...
And we won't be able to perform well if we're too tired.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's get ready for tomorrow by having some of Shizuku's manjus!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Feel free to have as many as you like. That includes you two as well, Miku, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, thanks!
Then without further ado♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, this is pretty relaxing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're all enjoying them so much. I hope we can go into tomorrow feeling relaxed and refreshed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
What if we had some manjus before our show tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-They might suck out all the water from our mouths...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
Then, what if I brought over some tea and lay down a tarp for us to...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We won't have time for a picnic before we take the stage!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
Let's start our final meeting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Movement is gonna be the most important part of this performance, so keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. The venue for tomorrow's event, Shibuya Festa, has a very large stage... Our usual performance is going to feel fairly small by comparison.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which means we're gonna need to make use of the entire stage somehow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's not my strongest suit, but I promise to do my best...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, I don't think we have much to worry about. We've been practicing pretty hard, so it's not like the quality of our performance is gonna drop all of a sudden just because we're playing somewhere new.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Look at you with the big talk.
But I'm in complete agreement!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too...!
We should be able to give it everything we have like we normally do!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Exactly.
So, once we've returned, let's... Hm?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sorry to interrupt your meeting.
Here's your iced coffee and iced tea.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Much appreciated, MEIKO.
If anything, we should be thanking you more for allowing us to hold our meetings here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You don't need to thank me.
Especially if it means getting to make drinks for all of you like this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, I really enjoy seeing all of you during these sorts of serious discussions.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're fun to watch since these meetings lead to better performances.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
If anything, you guys should drop by more often!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...
Akito, your friend... Uh, Shota? He invited you to perform during tomorrow's event, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's so cool how you guys were invited to perform again after the show you put on during the Summer Festival!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
And you'll be headlining again, correct?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes.
But we're just the last of the amateurs that are going to be performing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Regardless, we're going to be the ones that really get the crowd going tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You all certainly sound motivated.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Especially Akito.
Is it because certain seniors of ours are performing right after us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Wonderlands×Showtime is performing directly after us...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd be lying if I said otherwise...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can all but guarantee that they're going to put on a show like no other, so we've gotta do everything we can to compete...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
Let's borrow some of their energy to do our possible best.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, all of you, get ready to give it everything you've got tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At last?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: At long last!!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Tomorrow's the big day!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. All of you seem much more excited than usual.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's because we finally get to do our show tomorrow! I can't wait to show everyone my acting prowess!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Also, Emu's probably excited because Rui's going to unveil his newest device here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: New device?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The thing that sent Tsukasa flying just now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, is that what caused Tsukasa to soar so high through the sky?! It was that device?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's pretty impressive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's become even easier and safer to fly! Well done, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I feel honored.
But a device can only shine as brightly as its user.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I am able to keep making these devices because you're willing to place your faith in me, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'll be looking forward to seeing good results tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
I, Tsukasa Tenma, future star, shall show you tomorrow just how great...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just let me know if you ever feel like flying even a little bit higher.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey...!
I wasn't finished with my line!
Why did you interrupt me with something so disturbing?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I have a suggestion!
Wanna prepare for our show tomorrow by imagining how well it's gonna go?! We can close our eyes and rehearse it in our heads!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A rehearsal in our heads? Where's this coming from?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Minori told me the other day that it helps her a lot!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Minori...? Oh, you mean Hanasato?
I suppose so. I've also heard that believing that you'll succeed leads to actual success.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it sounds interesting. Let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo! Alright, close your eyes and...
Start!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Emu, why are you giggling...?
I don't remember your character laughing during the opening scene...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The way Tsukasa soared through the sky just now was so wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, what are you imagining?! What about your own character?! You're just reminiscing at this point!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you two...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They all seem very motivated. I believe we can look forward to another good show.)
